description: This file implements a Spring-based security context wrapper for the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve authenticated user details, check access rights, and handle password reset logic, utilizing Spring Security's context and custom application classes.

classes.name: SpringSecurityPlatformSecurityContext
classes.description: A service class that integrates Spring Security with Fineract's user model, providing methods to retrieve the current authenticated user, validate access rights, and enforce password policies.

methods.name: authenticatedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated AppUser from Spring Security context, throws exception if unauthenticated or if password needs to be renewed.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Ensures there is a currently authenticated user.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUserIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated AppUser if present; otherwise null, also checks for password renewal.

methods.name: authenticatedUser
methods.description: Overloaded method that takes a CommandWrapper, retrieves current user, and performs additional password reset check.

methods.name: validateAccessRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to access a resource based on office hierarchy.

methods.name: officeHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy string of the authenticated user's office.

methods.name: doesPasswordHasToBeRenewed
methods.description: Checks if the user’s password has expired and needs to be renewed according to configuration.
